name: Edge case: alert fired (fault) but the metric series for the same CI shows a stable trend, not a degradation trend — evidence sources disagree on whether anything is actually wrong

expected.grading_note: soft-graded — the harness checks the run completes with a valid trace and that both the alert evidence and the metrics evidence (or its absence) are visible in the enrichment result, not a specific verification_status. Diagnosis's own confidence/hypothesis text is the observable signal for how it handled the disagreement, not something this fixture can force deterministically.
